Subject: Recap: Dedicated capacity qualification — latency, isolation, burst strategy

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap while it's fresh and to make sure we're aligned on next steps.

Summary of customer goals / pain points we heard:
- Production latency spikes during scheduled batch jobs and unpredictable peak inference windows (current 95th pct latency ~420ms). Goal: 95th < 150ms for user-facing endpoints.
- Data isolation requirement: per-tenant isolation for PHI-related models; must be compatible with HIPAA controls and customer-managed keys.
- Predictable throughput for bursty clinical workloads: sustained 200 qps with 4s average sequence length during peak windows; ability to burst to 400 qps for up to 30 minutes.
- Cost sensitivity for inference volume beyond pilot.

Recommendation (initial sizing / approach):
- Reserved dedicated pool: 4 x A100-class GPUs (8x for replication/HA if they want active-active region failover) with isolated tenant lanes.
- Burst pool: 2 x A100 pre-warmed nodes for short-term spikes and queuing headroom.
- SLA targets to propose: 99.95% uptime for the dedicated pool + 95th pct latency SLO of 150ms for the primary region, with cross-region fallback.
- Operational suggestions: canary rollout with 10% traffic for first 48 hours, prefix KV cache warm-up, and a baseline batching policy.

Requested items / next steps for alignment:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact and target budget for a 3-month pilot so we can produce a firm pilot quote (attached estimate).
2) Technical deep-dive to validate qps / sequence length assumptions and confirm quantization/precision constraints — can your infra lead do a 60-minute session next week?
3) Legal: we will start an NDA/POC MSA stub if you want standard Redwood terms (we can provide a clean copy).
4) I'll share a sizing worksheet and a short MAP doc (attached) — please fill the red-highlighted fields and we'll iterate.

Attachments: NeuroLytics-dedicated-estimate.xlsx (pilot pricing), NeuroLytics-MAP-v1.pdf (action map & timeline)

Proposed times for tech deep-dive (PST): Tue 11/23 10:00-11:00, Wed 11/24 09:00-10:00, Thu 11/25 13:00-14:00 — let me know which works and I'll send an invite.

Thanks — Naomi

On sizing: the 200 qps sustained / 400 qps burst assumptions are correct. For the pilot we want to validate latency at 200 qps with realistic payloads (avg seq ~450 tokens). If you can include tokenized payload estimates in the worksheet that'd help.

Also attaching the internal procurement SLA expectations doc (we'll send formally after the pricing).

On the pilot length: 3 months is fine, but pricing needs to include an optional month-to-month extension at the same rate or a defined uplift.

Appreciate quick turnaround on the firm quote — Daniel

Subject: Internal: NeuroLytics operational proposal (short)

Internal note — scope proposal based on Naomi's recap and Daniel/Aisha confirmation:
- Pilot configuration (recommended): 4 x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs in primary region, isolated tenant lanes (dedicated CIDR + KMS integration).
- Burst: 2 x A100 warm nodes attached to a short-lived burst pool with auto-warm trigger at 350 qps.
- Canary plan: route 10% traffic for 48 hours with automated rollback on latency SLO breaches.
- SLA: propose 99.95% uptime + 95th pct latency SLO of 150ms (exceptions for cross-region failover windows).
- Pricing ask: build a 3-month pilot line-item with an optional month-to-month extension at +10% uplift if exercised.

Operational asks from product/infra to validate before quote:
1) Confirm exact model precisions acceptable (FP16 vs 8-bit quant) and any accuracy/regression tolerances.
2) Validate expected tokenization (450 tokens average) in the sizing worksheet — affects batching profile.
3) Confirm whether NeuroLytics requires active-active multi-region (adds 2x replicate capacity).

I will draft the pilot SKUs and cost sheet, attach to Naomi's estimate, and link HubSpot deal HS-4521. Assigning internal owner: ben.carter@redwood.com.

- Ben
